- Text: Key Timeline — Article 1723 creates TWO clocks: (1) collapse must occur within 15 years of completion, and (2) the action must be filed within 10 years of the collapse. Both conditions must be satisfied. If collapse happens in year 14, the owner has until year 24 to sue.
[/SLATECAMP_UI_BLOCK]

Extracted summary:

- Text: Critical Note: Article 1723 liability is separate from and in addition to quasi-delict liability under Articles 2176–2194. Article 1723 covers structural collapse within 15 years; quasi-delict covers negligence-based damages with a 4-year prescriptive period. An architect may face claims under both regimes for the same project.
[/SLATECAMP_UI_BLOCK]
